title: Internal Hom on $\Dctf$ at all coefficient stages
statement:
Use the standing scheme setting [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]: fix a prime $\ell$ and a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$, with $p\ne\ell$, and let $X$ be separated of finite type over $k$. An admissible coefficient $\Lambda$ is one of the pulled-back condensed rings $A,\mathbf Z_\ell,\mathcal O_E,\mathbf Q_\ell,E,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ of [sk-def-localizing-closure], with $A$ finite commutative and killed by a power of $\ell$, and $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite. Use $\Dctf$ of [sk-def-sfb-constructible], the ambient relative derived tensor and internal Hom of [sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom], and $a^!$ of [sk-prop-sf-existence]. A locally constant perfect complex on a scheme $S$ means a complex which, on a pro-étale cover, is the scalar extension to $\Lambda_S$ of a bounded complex of finite projective $\Lambda(*)$-modules [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex, def-weil-pbc-strict-perfect-coefficient-package]. The extension $a_!$ for a locally closed immersion $a=i\circ u$ is $i_*u_!$, with $u$ open and $i$ closed, acting termwise [det-lem-int-tensor-projection].

Let $\Lambda$ be admissible. For $K,L\in\Dctf(X,\Lambda)$,
$\cHom_\Lambda(K,L)\in\Dctf(X,\Lambda)$. More precisely, if
$a:S\hookrightarrow X$ is a locally closed immersion and $P$ a locally constant
perfect complex on $S$, then

$$
\cHom_X(a_!P,L)\simeq Ra_*\cHom_S(P,a^!L)\simeq Ra_*(P^\vee\otimes^{\mathbf L}a^!L),
\qquad P^\vee=\cHom_S(P,\Lambda_S),
$$

in $D(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\Lambda)$, and every $K\in\Dctf(X,\Lambda)$ is obtained
from finitely many objects $a_!P$ of this form by shifts and cones.

proof.text: Use admissible bounded-constructibility triangulated closure and the existing finite-Tor well-definedness theorem. Their intersection dctfPred is triangulated and replete.

For a=j≫i apply locallyClosed_support_hom_model to obtain its genuine restricted adjunction, a representative N of L, the Dctf membership of G(N), and the ambient Hom isomorphism. The immersion source inherits its k-structure and is Noetherian and finite type; no source field-structure hypothesis is added.

For scalar-perfect P use locallyConstantPerfect_dual_constructible for the bounded-constructible dual and tensor--Hom isomorphism. Apply internalHom_dual_tor_amplitude, and translate its cohomology vanishings outside [-b,-a] using DerivedCategory.isGE_iff/isLE_iff. This puts the same specified dual in Dctf. Apply the existing tensor and direct-image stability clauses to dual tensor G(N), push the evaluation isomorphism through Ra_*, and transport its Dctf membership along the composite ambient Hom isomorphism. This proves the generator case and both displayed formulas.

Map a generator isomorphism contravariantly through derivedHom(-,L). Coherent native contravariant exactness equips that functor with shifts and a triangulated structure on the opposite category. Pull back dctfPred and then unop its property; Mathlib proves this Q triangulated. Transport isomorphisms by the same functor to prove repleteness.

Apply finite triangulated generation to Q, with the generator membership from Step 3, proving the membership clause for K. Apply the same generation theorem to an arbitrary replete triangulated property R containing internalHomGenerator, supplying the actual extension as its own generator via the identity isomorphism. Pair these conclusions with the adjunction and formulas from Step 3.

theorem internalHom_stability
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (k : Type u) [Field k]
    [Fact (ringChar k).Prime] [Fact (ringChar k ≠ ℓ)]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] (_hΛ : IsLocalizingAdmissibleCoefficient ℓ Λ)
    (K L : moduleDerived Λ X) (_hK : dctfPred Λ X K) (_hL : dctfPred Λ X L) :
    dctfPred Λ X (internalHomObj Λ X K L) ∧
    (∀ (S Sbar : Scheme.{u}) (a : S ⟶ X) (j : S ⟶ Sbar) (i : Sbar ⟶ X),
      (hj : IsOpenImmersion j) → (hi : IsClosedImmersion i) → a = j ≫ i →
      ∀ (P : moduleDerived Λ S), IsLocallyConstantPerfectComplex Λ S P →
      ∃ (h : ∀ N, localizingClosureProEtale Λ S N → localizingClosureProEtale Λ X
          ((locallyClosedExtension Λ j i hj hi).obj N))
        (G : (localizingClosureProEtale Λ X).FullSubcategory ⥤
          (localizingClosureProEtale Λ S).FullSubcategory),
        Nonempty (localizingLocallyClosedExtension Λ j i hj hi h ⊣ G) ∧
        ∃ N : (localizingClosureProEtale Λ X).FullSubcategory, N.obj = L ∧
          Nonempty (internalHomObj Λ X ((locallyClosedExtension Λ j i hj hi).obj P) L ≅
            (CondensedRing.lowerStar Λ a).rightDerivedFunctor.obj
              (internalHomObj Λ S P (G.obj N).obj)) ∧
          Nonempty ((CondensedRing.lowerStar Λ a).rightDerivedFunctor.obj
              (internalHomObj Λ S P (G.obj N).obj) ≅
            (CondensedRing.lowerStar Λ a).rightDerivedFunctor.obj
              (dualTensorObj Λ S P (G.obj N).obj))) ∧
    ∀ K' : moduleDerived Λ X, dctfPred Λ X K' →
      ∀ Q : ObjectProperty (moduleDerived Λ X), Q.IsTriangulated →
        Q.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms →
        (∀ J : moduleDerived Λ X, internalHomGenerator Λ X J → Q J) → Q K'
